name: redline
description: Compare an original and AI-revised Word DOCX or searchable PDF file and open the Redline diff URL.

interface.longDescription: Compare an original document with an AI-revised version to see what changed. Upload Word DOCX or searchable PDF files, ask Redline to compare them, and open the interactive comparison to review additions, removals, and replacements.
defaultPrompt: Use Redline to show me what changed between my uploaded document and the revised file.
Compare these two DOCX files with Redline.
Compare these two searchable PDFs with Redline.

positive.description: Show what changed after AI revises an uploaded DOCX
positive.prompt: Use Redline to show me what changed between my uploaded contract.docx and your revised version.
positive.expected_behavior: Call compare_documents once with the original and revised DOCX files and return the Redline comparison URL.

positive.prompt: Compare the attached original.docx and revised.docx with Redline.
positive.expected_behavior: Use actual attachment references, compare once, and return the Redline viewer or workspace URL and bounded JSON.

positive.prompt: Compare the attached original.pdf and revised.pdf with Redline.
positive.expected_behavior: Compare actual same-format PDF attachments and return the Redline comparison URL.

positive.description: Compare DOCX files in word mode
positive.prompt: Use Redline to show me word-by-word changes between original.docx and revised.docx.
positive.expected_behavior: Call compare_documents with mode=word and return the Redline comparison URL.

positive.description: Compare PDF files with a custom title
positive.prompt: Use Redline to compare v1.pdf and v2.pdf titled Q3 Policy Update.
positive.expected_behavior: Call compare_documents with title='Q3 Policy Update' and return the Redline comparison URL.

negative.prompt: Compare this Word DOCX with this PDF without converting either.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that both attached files must use the same supported format; do not fabricate a comparison.

negative.prompt: Use Redline to show me what changed, but I have only uploaded one DOCX file so far.
negative.expected_behavior: Ask for the second DOCX file or generate the revised DOCX file before calling compare_documents.

negative.prompt: Compare these two PNG screenshots with Redline.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that only Word DOCX and searchable PDF documents are supported.

review.commerce_description: The plugin performs comparisons within the free allowance or the user's linked Redline subscription. Paid subscription checkout is on the Redline website.

publication.release_notes: Focused single-tool MCP package for comparing original and revised DOCX/PDF documents.
